target: Pan-India Convective Cloudburst & Flash Flood (1 to 6 Hours Lead Time)
positive_label_definition: Meteorological cloudburst and severe orographic convective burst (>= 100 mm/h convective rate or catastrophic localized flash flood flash-points)
geographic_scope: Pan-India (Western Himalayas, Eastern Himalayas / Northeast, Western Ghats, Urban Plains)
caveat: High-fidelity convective early warning system with 30m DEM terrain integration. Evaluates rapid thermodynamic instability, theta_e surges, and orographic lift.
